question:
Select the number that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following series.

11, 20, 23, 44, 47, 92, 95,?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The difference of difference between the consecutives odd and even terms is ×2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9050b587526ed52e7de22db68cd8c038ab5dbf618edf394f130fd6340b9074f.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **option 2)**
